The '''Halls of Knowledge''' were storehouses of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] information on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phateem/Legends|Phateem]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
It was once the largest repository of Force-imbued artifacts in the galaxy and included in the list of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]] by [[Vicendi]] in [[10,000 BBY]]. A vital location of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], most items found in its collection were later scattered to Jedi facilities on [[Great Jedi Library/Legends|Ossus]], [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Jedi Enclave|Dantooine]], [[Crystal Cave/Legends|Ilum]], and [[Kamparas Jedi Training Center|Kamparas]].<ref name="TEA" /> Eventually, long before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Jedi eventually abandoned the halls, leaving the site to decay.<ref>[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook'']]</ref>
